summary: Imageepoch and Marvelous's Wii-exclusive turn-based RPG with music from Yasunori Mitsuda and collaborators.

entries.title: Arc Rise Fantasia

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps and test controller mapping before a full run.

primary.why: Arc Rise Fantasia only released on Wii; Dolphin upscaling is the highest-fidelity capture route for the complete game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped Wii disc image in Dolphin with a Classic Controller or mapped controller setup. Original Wii/Wii U hardware is the fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake/remaster exists; the planned European release was cancelled.
